approval: User supplied a flat pixel-dog breed sheet and explicitly requested this appearance for the dogs.
styleOrigin: Four illustration-only crops from the user-supplied pixel-dog style sheet; reference only, never actual dog identity.
styleDescription: Match the attached FLAT PIXEL DOG ICON examples. STYLE controls proportions; PHOTO supplies coat color, ear shape, markings and tail ONLY. Deliberately caricature the adult dog: a broad oversized rounded head taking about half the visible height, tiny squat torso, very short chunky 3-4 pixel legs, tiny muzzle. Do NOT trace the realistic photo silhouette, slender neck, tall body or long legs. Use a continuous bold near-black pixel outline, tiny filled black dot eyes, tiny nose and understated closed mouth. About 4-8 flat solid colors, almost no interior shading, no fur texture or lighting. Keep the entire dog INCLUDING ear tips, feet and complete outlined tail inside the central 28x28 area with clear space on all sides. Preserve the actual dog identity; do not copy the reference breed. NO white sticker border, drop shadow, text or props. Crisp native 32px cute game icon.

IDLE.motion: Stand in place with subtle breathing and one gentle blink. All four paws stay planted.

WALK.motion: Walk in place using a natural alternating four-legged canine gait. Lift and plant the paws in a readable slow walk.

RUN.motion: Run in place using a coordinated four-legged canine gallop, flexing front and hind legs.

SNIFF.motion: Lower the head to sniff the ground by the front paws, gently move the nose, then return to the starting pose. Keep paws planted.

TAIL_WAG.motion: Gently wag only the tail from side to side. All four paws planted; body and head stay still.

BACK_OFF.motion: Take small cautious backward steps in place while continuing to look in the original direction. Alternate paws in a reverse walking gait.

SIT.motion: Bend the hind legs and lower the hips into a natural seated dog pose. Front paws stay planted. End sitting and hold; do not stand again. Keep tail tucked beside the body.

LIE_DOWN.motion: Bend the legs, tuck front paws close under the chest, and lower chest and belly into a compact natural resting pose. Tail stays close to rump. End lying down and hold; do not stand again.

invariants: Actual full-body photo and a reviewed face crop are mandatory concept inputs.
The fixed style reference controls design only; photo controls identity only.
Never use text-only generation as an automatic fallback.
Review all four native seeds before animation; bind approval to their hashes.
Native 32x32 RGBA pixels are never blurred, resized or independently recentered.
Unknown rear/tail details remain identified as inference.
Repeated/uncertain paid requests are never submitted automatically.
Photo appearance must not be treated as verified temperament.
Assets remain local review outputs; production publication is a separate approval.
